in_hebrew.name: Emerald
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Green precious stone
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Emerald הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word smaragdos meaning 'green precious stone'. In Greek mythology, emerald was associated with Venus, the goddess of love.

in_latin.name: Emeraldus
in_latin.meaning: Emeraldus, nomen virile, significat viridi colore naturalem
in_latin.long_meaning: Emeraldus, nomen virile, significat viridi colore naturalem, unde etiam nomen gemmae Viridis, quae a Viridi, dea naturae, dicitur. In Ecclesia Christiana, nomen Emeraldus non est vulgare, sed raro invenitur in catalogo nominum. Nomen Emeraldus in contextu Christiano significat virtutem naturalem et bonitatem, quae per Christum Iesum venit.
